canonical_definition: The average total remuneration in Australian dollars per employee within the employer reporting unit's lower-middle pay quartile, as reported for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year. record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

canonical_definition: The average total remuneration in Australian dollars per employee across the employer reporting unit's total workforce, as reported for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year. Total remuneration is pay (base salary plus superannuation and other payments), not revenue or business income; the value is a pay level, not a pay gap.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

canonical_definition: The average (mean) gender pay gap in total remuneration for the employer reporting unit, as reported for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year. Total remuneration is pay (base salary plus superannuation and other payments), not revenue or business income. Stored by the publisher as a decimal fraction (0.244 = 24.4%); a negative value indicates a gap favouring women.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

canonical_definition: The average (mean) gender pay gap in base salary for the employer reporting unit, as reported for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year. Stored by the publisher as a decimal fraction (0.244 = 24.4%), not a whole percentage; a negative value indicates a gap favouring women. It is a pay gap, not a pay level or business income.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

canonical_definition: The median gender pay gap in total remuneration for the employer reporting unit, as reported for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year. Total remuneration is pay (base salary plus superannuation and other payments), not revenue or business income. Stored by the publisher as a decimal fraction (0.069 = 6.9%); a negative value indicates a gap favouring women.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

canonical_definition: The average (mean) gender pay gap in base salary for the employer reporting unit, as reported for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year. Stored by the publisher as a decimal fraction (0.244 = 24.4%), not a whole percentage; a negative value indicates a gap favouring women. It is a pay gap, not a pay level or business income.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

canonical_definition: The average total remuneration in Australian dollars per employee across the employer reporting unit's total workforce, as reported for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year. Total remuneration is pay (base salary plus superannuation and other payments), not revenue or business income; the value is a pay level, not a pay gap.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

canonical_definition: The average (mean) gender pay gap in total remuneration for the employer reporting unit, as reported for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year. Total remuneration is pay (base salary plus superannuation and other payments), not revenue or business income. Stored by the publisher as a decimal fraction (0.244 = 24.4%); a negative value indicates a gap favouring women.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

canonical_definition: The average total remuneration in Australian dollars per employee within the employer reporting unit's lower-middle pay quartile, as reported for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year. record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

canonical_definition: The average (mean) gender pay gap in base salary for the employer reporting unit, as reported for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year. Stored by the publisher as a decimal fraction (0.244 = 24.4%), not a whole percentage; a negative value indicates a gap favouring women. It is a pay gap, not a pay level or business income.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

canonical_definition: The average total remuneration in Australian dollars per employee across the employer reporting unit's total workforce, as reported for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year. Total remuneration is pay (base salary plus superannuation and other payments), not revenue or business income; the value is a pay level, not a pay gap.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

canonical_definition: The average (mean) gender pay gap in total remuneration for the employer reporting unit, as reported for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year. Total remuneration is pay (base salary plus superannuation and other payments), not revenue or business income. Stored by the publisher as a decimal fraction (0.244 = 24.4%); a negative value indicates a gap favouring women.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

canonical_definition: The average total remuneration in Australian dollars per employee within the employer reporting unit's lower-middle pay quartile, as reported for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year. record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

canonical_definition: The average (mean) gender pay gap in total remuneration for the employer reporting unit, as reported for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year. Total remuneration is pay (base salary plus superannuation and other payments), not revenue or business income. Stored by the publisher as a decimal fraction (0.244 = 24.4%); a negative value indicates a gap favouring women.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

canonical_definition: The average (mean) gender pay gap in total remuneration for the employer reporting unit, as reported for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year. Total remuneration is pay (base salary plus superannuation and other payments), not revenue or business income. Stored by the publisher as a decimal fraction (0.244 = 24.4%); a negative value indicates a gap favouring women.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

canonical_definition: The average total remuneration in Australian dollars per employee within the employer reporting unit's lower-middle pay quartile, as reported for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year. record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

canonical_definition: The average total remuneration in Australian dollars per employee across the employer reporting unit's total workforce, as reported for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year. Total remuneration is pay (base salary plus superannuation and other payments), not revenue or business income; the value is a pay level, not a pay gap.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

canonical_definition: The average (mean) gender pay gap in total remuneration for the employer reporting unit, as reported for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year. Total remuneration is pay (base salary plus superannuation and other payments), not revenue or business income. Stored by the publisher as a decimal fraction (0.244 = 24.4%); a negative value indicates a gap favouring women.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

canonical_definition: The average total remuneration in Australian dollars per employee across the employer reporting unit's total workforce, as reported for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year. Total remuneration is pay (base salary plus superannuation and other payments), not revenue or business income; the value is a pay level, not a pay gap.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

canonical_definition: The average (mean) gender pay gap in total remuneration for the employer reporting unit, as reported for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year. Total remuneration is pay (base salary plus superannuation and other payments), not revenue or business income. Stored by the publisher as a decimal fraction (0.244 = 24.4%); a negative value indicates a gap favouring women.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

canonical_definition: The average (mean) gender pay gap in total remuneration for the employer reporting unit, as reported for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting year. Total remuneration is pay (base salary plus superannuation and other payments), not revenue or business income. Stored by the publisher as a decimal fraction (0.244 = 24.4%); a negative value indicates a gap favouring women.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.

record_grain: One row per employer reporting unit for the 2024-25 WGEA Gender Equality Reporting, identified by Employer name plus Employer ABN; each row also carries a contextual 2023-24 comparison block of four GPG columns, so a row is an employer-year-pair record rather than a single-year measure.
